sources.label: Патчи Morphe для российских Android-приложений
sources.author: RU Apps
patch_list: Bypass RootBeer root detection
Stubs calls into the scottyab/rootbeer native root-checking library so it always reports a clean (non-rooted) result.
Disable analytics libraries
Disables runtime analytics tracking calls and initializers (AppMetrica, MyTracker, Firebase).
Disable analytics manifest components
Disables analytics and tracking components and metadata in AndroidManifest.xml.
Disable AppsFlyer

Disables AppsFlyer attribution/tracking: no-ops its SDK implementation's start() choke point (the actual activation entry point, called directly from app code — not manifest-gated in the v6+ SDK) and disables its install-referrer manifest…
Disable checkout tips
Removes courier tips UI and prevents tip IDs or tip API calls from being submitted.
Disable lottery and in-app pushes
Disables lottery onboarding and the in-app push SDK used for reward popups.
Disable telemetry
Disables Ozon analytics, attribution, crash reporting, and telemetry uploads.
Disable tip notifications
Suppresses Ozon push notifications asking the user to leave a pickup-point tip.
Hide account lottery and review feed
Removes the lottery entry banner and review feed shortcut from the account screen.
Hide Ozon Bank ad banner
Removes the advertising banner carousel from the Ozon Bank screen.
Hide seller rating prompt
Removes the post-purchase seller rating prompt.
Remove Ozon ads
Removes Ozon ad widgets, banner carousels, video ads, and PDP promo blocks.
Remove Ozon ads
Removes Ozon ad widgets, checkout promotions, floating promotions, banner carousels, and PDP promo blocks.
Show final prices only
Hides crossed-out prices, discount percentages, and redundant price rows in the cart total.
